ruleDefinitions.name: Greedy File Deletion Using Del
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the "del" builtin command to remove files using greedy/wildcard expression. This is often used by malware to delete content of folders that perhaps contains the initial malware infection or to delete evidence.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*del\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*erase\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\*\\\.au3.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\*\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\*\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\*\\\.js.*")))
